segments.name: Financial services
segments.description: Provides compliant banking, lending, and compliance services to financial institutions serving cannabis-related businesses.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one reportable segment providing financial services and banking solutions to CRBs under ASC 280, Segment Reporting.

revenueModel.text: The company earns fees from financial institution partners (primarily PCCU) for onboarding, account servicing, investment income on CRB deposits, and a share of loan program income on CRB loans.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue through fee income, investment income, and loan program income earned by providing these compliance and lending services to financial institutions serving the cannabis industry.
